rows.title: Happy path — clean steel invoice, 3-way match
rows.reason: Vendor verified, no duplicate, prices and quantities match PO and goods receipt, GST correct, arithmetic reconciles.

rows.title: Edge: 3rd split invoice overbills the PO
rows.reason: Only ₹1,14,000 of ₹1,57,000 (taxable) is supported by goods received / open PO quantity. ₹43,000 + GST held. Cumulative billing across split invoices exceeds the PO.

rows.title: Edge: perfect invoice, but bank account changed (BEC fraud pattern)
rows.reason: Bank account on the invoice differs from the verified account in the vendor master. The invoice itself announces the change.

rows.title: Edge: scanned invoice, no PO number — PO must be inferred
rows.reason: Vendor verified, no duplicate, prices and quantities match PO and goods receipt, GST correct, arithmetic reconciles.

rows.title: Edge: re-sent duplicate — new number format, new date, scanned
rows.reason: Probable duplicate of invoice SGS/26-27/0087 dated 2026-10-03 (paid) — same invoice number (after normalising separators/zeros), same amount ₹2,26,560, 42 days apart, same PO.

rows.title: Unit price +1.7% vs PO (within 2% tolerance)
rows.reason: Vendor verified, no duplicate, prices and quantities match PO and goods receipt, GST correct, arithmetic reconciles.

rows.title: Unit price +11.2% vs PO
rows.reason: Unit price exceeds PO by more than 2% — Tap Set M10 (3 pc) billed at ₹1,390 vs PO ₹1,250 (+11.2%). Over-billing: ₹2,800 + GST.

rows.title: Billed 200 inserts, only 150 received (3-way mismatch)
rows.reason: Only ₹61,500 of ₹82,000 (taxable) is supported by goods received / open PO quantity. ₹20,500 + GST held.

rows.title: Inter-state vendor charged CGST+SGST instead of IGST
rows.reason: Wrong GST type: supply from Tamil Nadu to Karnataka requires IGST, but invoice charges CGST+SGST. ITC on wrongly charged tax is not available to us.

rows.title: Vendor GSTIN on invoice fails checksum
rows.reason: GSTIN on invoice (29AFZPD1185M1ZX) is invalid and does not match the registered GSTIN 29AFZPD1185M1ZO. Input tax credit would be lost.

rows.title: Vendor not in vendor master, no PO
rows.reason: Sai Hydraulics & Pneumatics is not in the vendor master. No payment can be made to an un-onboarded vendor.

rows.title: Vendor blocked in master (KYC lapsed)
rows.reason: Coastal Logistics Pvt Ltd is blocked in the vendor master — KYC lapsed — PAN-Aadhaar link and bank re-verification pending since Aug 2026.

rows.title: Rates quoted inclusive of GST (must back-calculate)
rows.reason: Vendor verified, no duplicate, prices and quantities match PO and goods receipt, GST correct, arithmetic reconciles.

rows.title: Line amount ≠ qty × rate (vendor typo)
rows.reason: Line 1 amount does not equal quantity × rate (invoice overstated by ₹18,000).

rows.title: No invoice number on document
rows.reason: Invoice has no invoice number — it is not a valid GST tax invoice and cannot be booked or de-duplicated.
